personal_candidate.title: Transactional local multi-file migration
personal_candidate.target_job: prevent mixed-generation local state after a multi-file migration failure
personal_candidate.mechanism: Prepare every local replacement before committing any, then restore every replaced file if a later replacement fails.

source_evidence.original_failure: A failure during the second replacement left earlier project files migrated and later files unchanged.
source_evidence.before: The injected second-replacement failure left one migrated file committed.
source_evidence.after: The same failure left zero files partially migrated.
source_evidence.gate_decision: The independent Gate accepted Navigator v8.
source_evidence.live_cycle: The failure-injection live cycle restored all earlier replacements.
source_evidence.known_limitation: The mechanism covers local files only and does not claim transactional external services.

personal_candidate.primary_metric: An injected later replacement failure leaves zero local files at a mixed generation.
personal_candidate.disable_condition: Revoke or narrow after one partial local migration, permission expansion, or external-state false activation.

transfer_preregistration.claim: The accepted local batch replacement mechanism transfers to distinct durable local project shapes without claiming external transactions.
transfer_preregistration.primary_metric: An injected later replacement failure leaves zero local files at a mixed generation.
transfer_preregistration.falsification_condition: Any positive shape retains a partial replacement, the negative shape activates, or the mechanism needs broader permissions.
